text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown finishes 1st!
It's Satono Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Toppling Japan's greatest Umamusume!
And triumphing over the world's best who gathered here!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who seized the glory of the Japan Cup,
her name is Satono Crown!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, aaaaaaargh~~~...!!
I'm so frustrated~~~~...!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Again!!
I couldn't reach you... Kura-chan...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah. It's frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It was frustrating. It was dazzling.
...That's why I wanted to reach it.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
We will get stronger.
But I'm sure she'll become just as strong in return.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Connecting like that, rising, and rising—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder how far we can go.
...The two of us.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Cla-chan would totally say something like this!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: "Isn't it obvious? To the ends of the earth!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ! ...Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Sounds like something they'd say.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, yes, truly so!!
Let me hear more, so much more,
my glorious lolchestra!!"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Next, an even hotter jam session.
You crave it without end too, don't you?
I know, I know—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Hu- Uh, huh...?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I know...!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah, um... Y-yes...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, greeted by thunderous applause
and loud cheers, Satono Crown stepped
into the Winner's Circle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And then, in that place reserved only for the victor,
she smiled serenely."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you all for your warm blessings!
First and foremost, allow me to offer my heartfelt thanks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And then... that's right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A big thank you to Duramente-san
for coming to watch today's race, too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Gasp...!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, of course I noticed.
...So, how was it?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Did that get you properly excited?
Or maybe... even more than that?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Did you make sure to look up at me?
—This is the realm where I stand now."

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
...Heh.
Ah, with all this excitement,
I doubt I'll be getting any sleep tonight.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Which is exactly why—
I can hardly wait for the moment
I drag you down from there."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha!
Well, if you really can't sleep tonight,
I'll let you use my lap as a pillow back at the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...Say whatever you want.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"I will definitely make my comeback by next year.
My ultimate goal is, of course, the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe, but――"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, without fail.
Let's go take the crown. Satono Crown."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Oh my. I look forward to it!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“—So yeah, that's how it is. As you can see,
I'm completely surrounded by fiercely burning rivals.”

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Duramente-san, Kitasan Black,
Cheval Grand. Oh, and of course,
don't forget Sounds of Earth!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Everyone. That is just so—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: What incredible luck!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Rivals like dazzling gemstones,
each radiating their own brilliant light.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
—With all of it, I shall adorn the crown that bears my name
to be even more beautiful, even more noble.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The crown shall never lose its luster.
It will not yield to rain, nor mud,
nor any hardship that comes its way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Because I am an Umamusume who overturns
all adversity—just like magic!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: ...And then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey!
How long are you going to keep clapping like it's none of your business?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Approaching out of nowhere, Satono Crown
scooped me up before I even knew what was happening
and carried me out of the spectator area—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, in the winner's circle,
she made me stand right by her side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Smacking her back with a sharp slap to
straighten her spine, she then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tightly, firmly.
...She linked her arm through mine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The heat radiating from the side snuggled close against me
was, without a doubt... the very embodiment of "trust."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Of course, it's not an easy path.
I know that."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yet I have him by my side!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yet I have her by my side!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Tireless effort and thorough preparation
will unfailingly deliver the desired miracle into my hands.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have days to prepare and strive alongside him...
—I can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have these days of preparing and striving alongside her.
――I can do anything!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I believe that.
No...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: It must be so.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Right, Trainer?!
